name: ambiguous
description: Vague requirement. The requirements stage detects ambiguity, pauses for human clarification, records the answers as explicit assumptions and then continues.
requirement: Make our links safer and faster.
clarifications: safe,malicious,phishing,malware,blocklist,threat,abuse=>Block malicious and private-network target URLs and rate limit abusive clients; links must also support expiry.
fast,latency,p95,performance,throughput,speed=>p95 redirect latency under 50 ms at 500 req/s; click analytics must be recorded asynchronously.
